items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Adolph Sutton as a 'dear friend' of the interviewer, not the interviewee. The interviewee does not mention Adolph Sutton.

ctx.x: That's the first time Buddy Rich ever called me in my whole entire life. Here I was sitting with you, his dear friend, and he calls me from Florida. Here a guy calls me that I don't even know about a thing with Adolph Sutton another dear friend, a tremendous jazz musician. It's just unbelievable, here we're sitting doing the same type of thing. Now, to get back to what we were talking about, about Chick. If you want to continue with Chick it's all right. If not I'd like to ask you another question.
Naturally, about Mr. Webb. Mr. Webb gave me
